info.title: OpenCut automation tool API
info.description: Domain and legacy automation endpoints plus raw project-upload chunks, scoped project media reads, published artifact bytes and public event SSE. Legacy v1 job paths are host-local and are not remote URLs.

post.description: Owner-only live SQLite page/freelist and database/WAL/SHM file observations. Reports whether this managed connection uses the control-admitted VFS; whole-workspace physical enforcement and repair remain unavailable. File sizes and connection-local settings are non-atomic observations, not reserved space.

200.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

default.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

post.description: Owner-only explicit passive or truncate WAL checkpoint. Reports complete, blocked or not_applicable; timeout bounds lock waiting, not filesystem IO. Does not delete history, vacuum, terminate readers or guarantee free space. Repeat only explicitly; results are live observations, not durable idempotency receipts.

200.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

default.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

post.description: Owner-only read-only admission policy, payload observation and durable reservations. Optional control section reports a separate database limit and observed files, but write interception is not yet enabled. No files created or recovery performed; volume space is observational and all workspace writers are not covered.

200.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

default.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

post.description: Owner-only persist payload and optional independent database-control limits with expected revision and stable idempotency key. Omitted control limit preserves it. Lower limits affect new reservations and growth; already admitted writes may finish. Does not delete data or change upload source quotas.

200.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

default.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

post.description: Owner-only reconcile crashed payload and control reservations using OS lifetime locks, then observe current managed bytes. Never expires a live writer by clock or deletes files. SQLite write interception and whole-workspace enforcement are not yet enabled.

200.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

default.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

post.description: Owner-only bounded discovery of durable CAS collection plans. Defaults to unfinished plans. Limit bounds examined rows, so an empty filtered page may still have next_cursor. Forward cursor is bound to the filter and a stored plan in this workspace; plan states are observed live. Query never executes collection.

200.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

default.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

post.description: Owner-only: persist a reviewed collection plan for unreferenced canonical CAS objects and abandoned capture temporaries. Protects all retained revisions, accepted jobs and project media. No file deletion. Idempotent key; cursor enumerates live namespace. Does not reclaim artifacts or impose quotas.

200.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

default.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

post.description: Owner-only: inspect a durable CAS collection plan and per-object outcomes. Removing means unresolved; explicitly retry execute. Does not change the plan or files.

200.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

default.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

post.description: Owner-only: explicitly execute the exact reviewed plan hash. Rechecks all references under the CAS publication gate. Newly referenced or changed objects are retained. Durable receipts support crash recovery; retry the same plan, never infer reclaimed disk bytes from logical sizes.

200.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

default.description: OpenCut response envelope; inspect error.code on failure.

post.description: Owner-only bounded native storage observation. Reports managed categories, unique inode bytes, partial scans and volume availability without exposing paths. Live scan, not an atomic snapshot, quota reservation or garbage-collection plan. Never deletes or repairs files.

post.description: Create an idempotent project upload session. Requires read+edit+run_jobs. Send raw chunks through the authenticated HTTP data endpoint advertised by capabilities; never include media bytes or host paths in tool JSON.

put.description: Send sequential raw bytes with a complete SHA-256 and canonical decimal offset/size. Maximum 4194304 bytes per chunk, 1073741824 bytes per upload, 16 concurrent requests and 60 seconds receiving. A lost response has an unknown outcome: inspect the confirmed next_offset before retrying identical bytes. Project read, edit and run_jobs permissions are required.

200.description: Confirmed upload state and next_offset.

default.description: Structured OpenCut error envelope; inspect error.code before retrying.

get.description: Read the verified fixed bytes of an imported project media resource. Requires the current project's read grant; the opaque media ID does not grant access by itself. Long responses revalidate authorization after policy changes. The response is not a host path or an owner-only global media URL.

200.description: Verified media bytes with detected Content-Type and Content-Length.

default.description: Structured OpenCut error envelope; inspect error.code before retrying.

get.description: Download the bytes of a published job artifact identified by job ID and SHA-256. Authorization and integrity are checked against the committed job; a historical successful job does not guarantee that its file remains available. Content-Type identifies the actual media format.

200.description: Verified artifact bytes, with actual Content-Type and Content-Length headers.

default.description: Structured OpenCut error envelope; inspect error.code before retrying.

post.description: Observe public project or job changes with an opaque cursor. SSE data contains one opencut.events.v1 record; the SSE id is its resume cursor. Last-Event-ID overrides the body cursor. Reconnect using the last fully processed id. Closing observation does not cancel durable tasks.

200.description: SSE ready/change/error records; each data field is JSON matching x-opencut-data-schema.

default.description: Structured OpenCut error envelope; inspect error.code before retrying.
